Puzzle 1194 826669

Problems & Puzzles: Puzzles

Puzzle 1194 826669
826669 Is the smallest prime of the form a^a + b^b + c^c containing the beast number. [Post]. See the following Curio.

Q1. What are the a, b & c values, for 826669?

Q2. Find 5 more like these.

From Oct 26 to Nov 2, 2024, contributions came from Michael Branicky, JM Rebert, Emmanuel Vantieghem, Gennady Gusev

Jeff Heleen and Adam Stinchcombe

***

Michael wrote:

It is quite easy to find such numbers. For example, searching all 1 <= a <= b <= c <= 100, we find

1^1 + 5^5 + 7^7 = 826669

Rebert wrote:

Q1. [a, b, c] = [1, 5, 7]

Q2. With 0 < a <= b <= c <= 200, I found 485 cases:

n [a, b, c]

1 [1, 5, 7] 6-digit prime (666 at position 3)

2 [1, 11, 77] 146-digit prime (666 at position 132)

3 [1, 23, 167] 372-digit prime (666 at position 83)

4 [1, 42, 138] 296-digit prime (666 at position 187)

5 [2, 8, 77] 146-digit prime (666 at position 132)

...

480 [149, 178, 178] 401-digit prime (666 at position 263)

481 [150, 181, 188] 428-digit prime (666 at position 348)

482 [154, 172, 197] 453-digit prime (666 at position 21)

483 [162, 162, 167] 372-digit prime (666 at position 142)

484 [166, 167, 170] 380-digit prime (666 at position 155)

485 [171, 172, 174] 390-digit prime (666 at position 297)

a, b, c -> sum

7, 5, 1 -> 826669

22, 8, 3 -> 341427877364219557396663500827

27, 16, 2 -> 443426488243037769966696374692859444423

47, 16, 2 -> 3877924263464448622666648186154330754898344901344205917642344074630570094614483

47, 24, 18 -> 3877924263464448622666648186154330754898344902677941694531956160410874395482063

50, 48, 37 -> 8882284899079515782708227892306947026666030124033707486218854203868480905047351845973

There are 63 such numbers for a, b, c < 100.

Jeff Heleen wrote:

For puzzle 1194 I have 6 more solutions. I used a short Python program

to generate a list, then used YAFU / aprcl batchfile to test for primality.

3^3 + 8^8 + 22^22 = 341427...666...3500827 (30 digits)

2^2 + 16^16 + 27^27 = 443426...666...444423 (39 digits)

2^2 + 16^16 + 47^47 = 387792...666...614483 (79 digits)

3^3 + 14^14 + 68^68 = 407949...666...291419 (125 digits)

2^2 + 8^8 + 77^77 = 181880...666...7774017 (146 digits)

2^2 + 22^22 + 101^101 = 273186...666...666...233689 (203 digits)
***

Adam wrote:

I get the list of a,b,c values that follow, sorted in order by the sum a+b+c. I think for many of these, the 666 is appearing in the really big a^a value, and then the

much smaller b^b and c^c values are just making the sum prime.

[1, 5, 7], [3, 8, 22], [2, 16, 27], [2, 16, 47], [3, 14, 68], [2, 8, 77], [18, 24, 47], [4, 15, 70], [1, 11, 77], [18, 21, 56], [3, 40, 56], [21, 26, 56], [11, 40, 56], [10, 33, 64],

[12, 16, 79], [4, 11, 98], [18, 33, 64], [24, 39, 56]
